name: TasksHeadersTolerateMcpMethodOnToolsCall
description: Server tolerates Mcp-Method request header on tools/call (sync tool dispatch unaffected)

name: Sep2663RoutingHeadersAcceptedOnTasksGet
description: Server accepts matched Mcp-Method + Mcp-Name request headers on tasks/get and dispatches normally

name: TasksHeadersRejectMismatchedMethod
description: When Mcp-Method header disagrees with body on a tools/call, server MUST reject with -32020 HeaderMismatch (SEP-2243 §Server Validation)

name: Sep2663ServerRejectsMismatchedMcpNameOnTasksGet
description: When Mcp-Name header disagrees with params.taskId on tasks/get, server MUST reject with -32020 HeaderMismatch
errorMessage: tasks/get with mismatched Mcp-Name returned a result; SEP-2243 requires -32020 rejection

name: WireSchemaValid
description: Every JSON-RPC message the implementation sent is valid per the spec JSON schema for the negotiated spec version
